name: Peek Rating
description: Interactive rating row where hovering or dragging lifts the icons up to the pointer, magnifies the hovered one and shows a floating tooltip label, with a pop animation on commit.
contents: Row of rating icons (star, heart or bolt, or a custom icon)
Floating tooltip pill above the row showing the hovered value or custom label
behavior: Hover or press-and-drag previews a value: icons up to the pointer lift and the hovered one scales up
Tooltip slides between icons and shows the label or number
Release or tap commits the value with a pop scale animation; selecting the current value again clears it when allowClear is on
Keyboard support: arrows, Home, End, Backspace/Delete, Space/Enter, with roving tabindex
Touch uses drag-to-preview with no hover needed
editableByProps: Value (controlled or initial), number of icons, icon shape or custom icon
Active, idle, tooltip and tooltip text colors
Icon size, lift distance, magnify and pop scale, rise duration
Read-only, disabled, clearing behavior, aria label

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the commit pop keyframes or duration
needsCodeEdit.where: glyph.animate call inside the commit function
className of the span with ref tipEl

fixed: Does not center itself; renders as an inline-flex element in the normal flow
Requires the @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons packages for the built-in shapes
Adds document visibilitychange and window blur listeners to reset the preview, removed on unmount
Tooltip is hidden when readOnly or disabled
Touch targets grow to 44px minimum on coarse pointers; fits 360px screens for typical counts but a large size with many icons can overflow
Component handles pointer drag with setPointerCapture, so a parent with its own pointer handling may conflict

options.useWhen: Product or service reviews where a standard star rating is expected
Favorites, likes or satisfaction ratings on lifestyle, food or social pages
Energy, speed or difficulty ratings on tech, fitness or gaming pages
